data.text: How about this for this month: John and Kate catch 12 tons each, Jack and Emma catch 10 each, and I catch 6? I’ll voluntarily take $6,000 so John and Kate can each earn $12,000. That totals 50 tons, leaving 50 to double back to 100 for next month if everyone follows the proposal. I’ll keep my own catch at 6 tons this month; the others’ shares still need your agreement. In future months, we could discuss rotating who takes the smaller share. John, would you be willing to take 12 tons under this plan?
